q: According to the Red Book 2017, how much Notice must the Engineer give of his intention to attend tests?
explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Red Book 2017, Sub-Clause 7.4.

q: According to the Red Book 2017, if the Engineer does not attend tests at the time and place stated in the Contractor's Notice, what happens?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The Contractor may proceed, and the tests are deemed to have been made in the Engineer's presence

explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Red Book 2017, Sub-Clause 7.4.

q: According to the Red Book 2017, if the Engineer gives no Notice within how many days after receiving the Contractor's proposal for remedial work, he is deemed to have given a Notice of No-objection?
explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Red Book 2017, Sub-Clause 7.5.

q: According to the Red Book 2017, when does Plant become the property of the Employer?

choices.label: A
choices.text: At the earlier of delivery to the Site or when the Contractor becomes entitled to payment of its value under Sub-Clause 8.11

choices.label: D
choices.text: On signing of the Contract Agreement

explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Red Book 2017, Sub-Clause 7.7.
